packages.name: Siargao Island Surf & Nature Retreat
packages.description: Escape to the surfing capital of the Philippines and ride the world-famous Cloud 9 waves. Beyond the surf, explore Siargaos stunning lagoons, secret beaches, and palm tree-lined roads. This package includes a guided island-hopping tour, visits to Sugba Lagoon and Magpupungko Rock Pools, and a taste of Siargaos laid-back nightlife. Perfect for both thrill-seekers and nature lovers.
packages.address: General Luna, Siargao Island, Surigao del Norte, Philippines

packages.name: Banaue Rice Terraces Heritage Tour
packages.description: Discover the breathtaking beauty of the Banaue Rice Terraces, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the greatest engineering marvels of ancient times. Immerse yourself in the rich culture of the Ifugao people as you explore the centuries-old terraces carved into the mountains. Visit the Batad and Bangaan viewpoints for panoramic views of the lush green landscape. Enjoy a cultural experience by staying in an Ifugao hut and witnessing traditional dances. Hike through the scenic trails and take in the fresh mountain air for an unforgettable nature retreat.

tiers.name: Comfort Trekker

packages.name: Palawan Island Paradise
packages.description: Palawan, known as the "Last Frontier of the Philippines," is home to pristine beaches, crystal-clear lagoons, and breathtaking limestone cliffs. Explore the Underground River, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and witness its stunning rock formations. Take a boat tour to El Nido's enchanting islands, where hidden lagoons and white-sand beaches await. Snorkel in the rich marine biodiversity of Corons Twin Lagoon and Kayangan Lake. Indulge in fresh seafood and relax in luxurious beach resorts for the ultimate island getaway.

tiers.name: Backpackers Island Escape
tiers.description: An affordable package designed for backpackers who want to explore Palawans stunning islands on a budget.

tiers.name: Luxury Seaside Getaway
tiers.description: A luxurious stay in a top-rated beachfront resort with a private island-hopping experience for a truly unforgettable escape.

packages.name: Mount Fuji Climbing Expedition
packages.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to Japans iconic Mount Fuji, the countrys highest and most picturesque peak. Experience the thrill of hiking along the Yoshida Trail and witness breathtaking sunrise views from the summit. Visit the Fuji Five Lakes region, where serene landscapes provide a perfect escape. Enjoy a relaxing dip in a traditional Japanese onsen (hot spring) after a long day of trekking. Capture postcard-perfect moments at Chureito Pagoda with Mount Fuji in the background.

tiers.name: Hikers Challenge
tiers.description: Designed for adventure seekers looking to conquer Mount Fuji with the guidance of expert mountaineers.

tiers.name: Mount Fuji Climbing Expedition
tiers.description: A relaxed and scenic journey to Mount Fuji with personalized assistance and a comfortable stay in a luxury hot spring resort.

packages.name: Bohols Chocolate Hills Adventure
packages.description: Witness one of the Philippines most unique natural wonders, the Chocolate Hills, a collection of over 1,200 cone-shaped hills. Explore the scenic viewpoints and marvel at the breathtaking panoramic landscape. Enjoy an exciting ATV ride through the Chocolate Hills Adventure Park. Cruise along the Loboc River while dining on delicious Filipino cuisine. Meet the worlds smallest primate, the tarsier, at a local sanctuary.

tiers.name: Thrill Seekers Ride
tiers.description: Perfect for adventure lovers who want to explore the Chocolate Hills up close with an extended ATV ride and an exciting zip-line experience.

tiers.name: Nature & Culture Escape
tiers.description: A relaxed yet immersive experience that combines Bohols stunning natural landscapes with cultural insights and local wildlife encounters.

packages.name: Niagara Falls Majestic Getaway
packages.description: Experience the thundering beauty of Niagara Falls, one of the most famous waterfalls in the world. Take a boat ride on the Maid of the Mist and feel the refreshing spray of the falls up close. Stroll along the Niagara Parkway for stunning views of Horseshoe Falls, American Falls, and Bridal Veil Falls. Visit the nearby Clifton Hill district for entertainment, dining, and attractions. End your trip with a scenic helicopter ride for a birds-eye view of the spectacular cascades.

tiers.name: Falls Explorer Package
tiers.description: Experience the raw power of Niagara Falls up close with a thrilling boat tour and stunning panoramic views from the observation deck.

tiers.name: Luxury Falls Retreat
tiers.description: A premium experience with breathtaking aerial views of the falls, a luxurious hotel stay, and exclusive guided tours.

packages.name: Sydney Opera House & City Escape
packages.description: Discover the vibrant city of Sydney, home to the iconic Sydney Opera House and the picturesque Sydney Harbour. Take a guided tour inside the Opera House and learn about its fascinating history and architecture. Stroll along the Sydney Harbour Bridge for stunning views of the city skyline. Explore the beautiful Bondi Beach and take a scenic coastal walk. Enjoy a sunset dinner cruise along the harbour for a magical end to your trip.

packages.name: Grand Canyon Adventure Trek
packages.description: Witness the awe-inspiring beauty of the Grand Canyon, one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. Hike along the South Rim and explore breathtaking viewpoints like Mather Point and Desert View. Experience a thrilling whitewater rafting trip along the Colorado River. Take a helicopter tour for a stunning aerial perspective of the canyons vast landscapes. Enjoy a night under the stars at a scenic camping site for an unforgettable adventure.
